title: Workflow idea record
description: One workflow or broadcast this project does not have yet and arguably should, recorded so the idea can be judged before anyone builds a review surface for it. Subject is `idea:<slug>`.

idea_schema_version.description: Definition version. Charts filter on it, so bump it when a field's meaning changes.

idea_kind.description: A workflow fires per person on a trigger. A broadcast goes to an audience once.

idea_title.description: What a person would name this workflow in the list.

audience.description: Who it reaches, in terms this project can filter on: an event, a property, a cohort, a group. Not a persona.

trigger_kind.description: What starts it. `event` fires per person, `schedule` on a cadence, `batch` over an audience once.

trigger_name.description: The project's own event or action name, copied exactly, or the cadence for a schedule.

trigger_verified_count.description: Times this event fired in the project over the window, read from the project before naming it. Required for an event trigger: an event you cannot count does not exist here, and the idea is not recordable.

message_outline.description: What the message says and what it asks the reader to do. Concrete enough to judge, not a finished draft.

reach_people.description: Distinct people the trigger matched over the window. The denominator for whether this is worth anyone's time.

window_days.description: Days the reach was measured over.

existing_coverage.description: Whether a live workflow already messages this audience at this moment. `partial` means one exists but misses the moment or the audience.

covered_by.description: The workflow id already covering it, when coverage is `partial`.

confidence.description: How sure the scout is that this is worth building, given reach, coverage and how cleanly the trigger reads.

why_now.description: What in the data makes this worth doing now rather than any other week.
